title: Set-ins by other bassists: George Joyce and Wellman Braud
summary: Garland let other bassists sit in and says he schooled Joyce and Wellman Braud; Braud later played with Duke.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Bass players: lineage, tone and technique
